usage.title: Usage & quotas
usage.description: Token consumption against this workspace's daily and monthly limits, plus cumulative cost across all answers.
usage.quotaDescription: Counters live in Redis and reset at the end of each UTC window. A limit of 0 means that window is unlimited.
usage.degradedDescription: Quota enforcement and counting depend on Redis. If Redis is temporarily unreachable, the system fails open: requests are allowed through and are not counted against the quota until the cache recovers. This keeps chat available during a transient cache outage at the cost of brief over-allowance (see the architecture notes, §3). The meters above show “degraded mode” whenever counters cannot be read.
usage.exceeded: Quota exceeded — new answers are blocked until the window resets.
usage.countersUnavailable: Usage counters are currently unavailable (Redis unreachable). The system is running in degraded mode: requests are allowed through and not counted against the quota until the cache recovers.
